blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is scheduled to have bilateral meetings with leaders of United States, Japan, Australia, Brazil and South Korea. This was confirmed by Asean spokesperson Dominic Xavier Imperial to reporters on Friday.
